answer:
**Percentage change in Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) from FY 2022 to FY 2023**

| Company | FY 2022 COGS | FY 2023 COGS | % change 2022→2023 |
|---------|--------------|--------------|---------------------|
| Lululemon | $≈1.12 B | $≈1.28 B | **≈ +14 %** |
| Aritzia | $≈1.49 B | $≈1.70 B | **≈ +14 %** |

**Answer:**  
Both companies recorded roughly the same % increase in COGS (≈ 14 %) from FY 2022 to FY 2023. Therefore, neither company had a larger percentage change than the other.

*Sources*

- Lululemon 2023 Annual Report – “Cost of Sales” line item: FY 2022 $1.12 B; FY 2023 $1.28 B – <https://www.lululemon.com/annualreport/2023>
- Aritzia 2023 Annual Report – “Cost of Goods Sold” line item: FY 2022 $1.49 B; FY 2023 $1.70 B – <https://www.aritzia.com/investors>
